content: Dawiti Saa7ola Hayquwa Si7is
Saa7oli hayqidaape guye, Dawiti Amaaleqata xooni simmidi Xiqilaagan nam7u gallas gam7is.
Heedzantho gallas issi addey ba ma7uwa daakidi, ba huuphen baana qolidi, Saa7oli dunkaanida gutaape yis. I Dawitako yidi sa7an gufannidi ziggis.
Dawiti, “Neeni awape yadii?” yaagidi oychis. I zaaridi, “Taani Isra7eeleti dunkaanida gutaape kessa ekada yas” yaagis.
Dawiti, “Ane hanidaba taw oda” yaagis. I zaaridi, “Nu olanchoti olape baqatidosona; nu asaape daroti hayqidosona; Saa7olinne iya na7ay Yoonataani hayqidosona” yaagis.
Dawiti iyaw odida panthaa, “Saa7olinne iya na7aa Yoonataani hayqidaysa neeni aybin eray?” yaagidi oychis.
Panthay, “Taani Gilbo7a deriya bolla de7ishin, Saa7oli ba toora guufetidi eqidaysa be7as; para gaaretinne para asati Saa7olako matatidosona.
He wode Saa7oli guye simmidi tana demmidi xeegis. Taani, ‘Yee’ yaagada koyas.
Saa7oli, ‘Neeni oonee?’ yaagidi oychin, ‘Taani Amaaleqa asi’ yaagada zaaras.
Hessafe guye, Saa7oli, ‘Taani madunxada, hayqos gakas; neeni ta bolla keyiya eqada tana wodha’ yaagis.
I kundidaape guye hayqope attonnaysa erida gisho taani iya bolla keya eqada iya wodhas. Iya huuphen de7iya kallachanne iya qesen de7iya ambaariya ekada neeko ta godaako yas” yaagis.
Dawitinne Dawita asay kayotidi, banta ma7uwa daakidosona.
Enti Saa7oli, Yoonataani, Godaa olanchotinne Isra7eele asay olan wurida gisho omarsi gakanaw kayotidosona; yeekidosona; xoomidosona.
Dawiti hessa entaw ehida panthaa, “Ne awupe yadii?” yaagidi oychis. I zaaridi, “Taani bete asi gididi de7iya Amaaleqa addiya na7a” yaagis.
Dawiti, “Goday tiyida kawa wodhanaw ne kushiya denthashe waanada yayyabikii?” yaagis.
Dawiti ba asatape issuwa xeegidi, “Iya wodha” yaagin, I Amaaleqa panthaa caddidi wodhis.
Dawiti Amaaleqa addiyako, “Goday tiyida kawa taani wodhas” yaagada “Neeni ne doonan markatida gisho ne suuthaa gomey nena oyko” yaagis.
Dawiti Saa7olasinne Yoonatanas Yeekis
Dawiti Saa7olasinne iya na7aa Yoonatanas haysada yaagidi zeleelis.
Yihuda asay, “Donge yeeho” geetetiya ha zelelsa tamaarana mela kiittis; ha zelelsay Yaashara
maxaafan xaafetis.

content.text: Filisxeeme macca nayti hessa si7idi ufaytonna mela,
qaxaretiboona asaa macca nayti hashshu goonna mela,
hinte bolla iri bukofo; aki wodhofo.
He bessan wolqaamata gondalley tunida gisho,
hinte ma7uwa worqan alleeqisida Saa7olas yeekite.
Ta ishaa Yoonataana, ta new azzanayis;

content: yaagidi Dawiti zeleelis.
